column2: Every finite H needs one exponent uniform in epsilon and all H-free G; a restricted-family argument cannot establish this Erdős–Hajnal-strength assertion. No full-scope route.
Linear correction must work for every expander and inner code down to delta*d0>1; distance alone does not give a linear-time decoder. No algorithm with a proved progress invariant.
Literal variables, ambient space and truncated-density notation are missing. Source reconstruction required; a local FCC optimum would not establish global optimality over all packings.
All large n and matching sizes s require the exact extremal classification, with construction H² undefined locally. Small matching tests would give no uniform classification.
Perfect-matching threshold depends on an undefined two-parameter construction; divisibility of n and the exact source domain need checking. No full-scope route; wording fixes uncredited.
Threshold must depend only on maximum degree despite arbitrary order of F, with g allowed to depend on F. No bounded-degree uniform subdivision mechanism.

Weighted bisection invites a tiny certificate, but disconnected extensions of the excluded claw may only expose an omitted source hypothesis. Inspect source before treating such a witness as substantive.
Finite computational ranges cannot classify all distance sets of arbitrary cardinality and magnitudes. No bounded certificate or structural characterization found.

Labeling invariant requires source definition and possible connectedness/size exceptions. Arbitrary-graph two-value labeling has no supplied construction; isolated-vertex wording issues earn no credit.
Mixed-boundary eigenfunction maximum needs geometry-dependent PDE control over every triangle. Ambiguity about first positive nontrivial eigenfunction requires source fidelity; no short full route.
Pascal recurrence needs a dimension-reduction injection controlling overlaps for all k,d; boundary cases do not give it. Endpoint n(k,d-1) also needs conventions.
Splitting produces hierarchical codes, while optimal arbitrary codes need not be hierarchical. No universal transformation preserving cardinality and k-neighborliness; finite search not pursued.
Asymptotic error is smaller than the central binomial coefficient for every bipartite G. Neither the poset encoding nor a matching construction is supplied locally; no full route.
Continuity in integer exponents is vacuous without a specified continuous interpolation; largest t for all m,s versus for fixed m,s is ambiguous. Correcting this is not a discovery.
Maximal packing gives the known Delta*rho scale, but obtaining a connectedness saving of rho-1 requires an additional global exchange argument. No such invariant; do not repackage the weaker bound.
Needs a high-probability comparison of longest cycle and largest proper subsystem in a uniform Steiner model. No distributional control; finitely many systems cannot settle the limit.
Uniform random factorisation has dependent row cycles and subsystems. No full high-probability estimate or constructive certificate route.
Existence of a Hamilton row cycle in almost every Latin square is a random-structure statement, not a single example. No tractable proof route.
Constant spectral ratio uniformly in n needs global Hamiltonicity machinery; fixed density or growing ratio results do not cover it. No new mechanism and no current-body status clearance.
Polynomial lower-bound conjectures conflict in order with next row's linear claim for the same posets. Must resolve source chronology and bodies; no inference from metadata.
Source text reports t=2 determined linear, which would defeat part of previous row if definitions agree. General fixed s,t lower bound still not proved here; primary-body HOLD.
For k>2 and growing Delta, independent list assignment still creates correlated obstructions. No uniform union bound meeting both scales established; k=2 excluded as a parameter instance.

All hypergraphs on fewer than twenty vertices is an enormous unconstrained game-class search. Arbitrary edge subsets and distinct game rules need source definitions; no small exhaustive certificate route.

Weighted optimum must be achieved within |F| exchanges of every chosen minimum basis, not merely some avoiding basis. Ordinary exchange does not preserve this optimality constraint; inspect source before investing.
Uniform positive constant over arbitrary digraphs is far stronger than regular-digraph bounds. Girth of acyclic graphs and path conventions need source domain; no full route.
Literal statement already attributes a proof to its own source. Source-body confirmation needed before definitive retirement; no discovery eligibility from reproving refined absorption.
Universal forbidden oriented H and polynomial dichromatic saving would need a major structural mechanism. No acyclic-set extraction controlling the colouring quantifier.
All forbidden tournaments is Erdős–Hajnal scale; special H cases cannot establish the universal quantifier. No small full-scope route.
Finiteness for every fixed ell and all sufficiently large k needs disjoint directed cycles with distinct lengths; one-cycle bounds do not supply disjointness. No constructive threshold.
Global measurable optimum cannot follow from verifying the given non-KS valuation. No upper-bound dual certificate or improved positive-measure construction.
Every bipartite H needs an n-uniform comparison to ex(n,H), with unrestricted f_H(t). Standard KST upper bounds need not match ex(n,H); no valid bridge supplied.
Finite c range still grows with unbounded a, and tilted height/box require exact definitions. A small-a partition is a helper, not the full standard-partition mechanism.
Sharp coefficient one and simultaneous part-count control require global connectivity partition surgery. Checking complete graphs or small k does not address arbitrary n,k.
Only six dimensions but arbitrary lattices remain unbounded objects. Requires a universal Gram/lattice obstruction, not a catalogue of classical lattices; no finite certificate reduction.
Four dimensions do not bound lattice possibilities. Matching examples alone cannot prove optimality over all lattices; no universal upper-bound route.
Z^n gives ratio identically one, exposing argmin uniqueness wording only. Functional-equation symmetry does not prove a minimum for arbitrary unimodular lattices; no substantive full route.
Linear bounds do not give existence of D(n)/n limit. No near-superadditivity or composition theorem preserving the Waiter strategy.
Arbitrary tight forms may lack regularity and attained maxima on noncompact closure. Smooth-case principles cannot bridge weak regularity; wording corrections excluded.
All dimensions and lattice polytopes require integer decomposition for every r. Edge length alone does not supply a triangulation with a controlled normality certificate; no bounded full route.
Uniform constant c with linear m threshold needs remove quadratic dependence on n,p in size-Ramsey extremal arguments. No matching universal lower/upper construction.
All trees with arbitrary degrees require a uniform spectral-gap constant at every fugacity below e-1. Reconstruction intuition does not give a Poincaré inequality; no full mechanism.
Every sufficiently large admissible order and every fixed chromatic number requires resolvability plus exact chromatic control. Existing nonresolvable constructions are insufficient.
Triangle dijoin suggests rank-one augmentation, but lower bound requires exact tournament-minimum-rank conventions and source results. No universal rank certificate proved.
Strict asymptotic separation needs compatible ordinary upper and rectilinear lower bounds with different leading behaviour or enough lower-order slack. Finite n examples insufficient.

Statement explicitly reports public counterexamples. Do not count independent refutation; exact counterexample bodies not inspected here, so retain source confirmation HOLD rather than assert audited resolution.
Three fixed rectangles needs a complete NP-hardness gadget reduction while retaining simply connected regions. A 111-tile reduction does not supply this; large formal/reduction burden.
Sparsity definition not local, and quantifiers for every H,c demand a uniform sparse-host theorem. Ordinary induced-subdivision existence does not yield the claimed extremal count.
Every genus except two needs explicit near-triangular embeddings attaining a crossing lower bound. Sporadic genus constructions cannot establish the family; no uniform surgery route.

Strict mean inequality includes diagonal equality and alpha=0 degeneracy; likely source has excluded endpoints or evaluates distinct arguments. Inspect actual definitions before credit; no numerical sign sweep as proof.
Random residual after maximum clique packing needs dependencies controlled at an error o(sqrt(mu_r)). Existing r=3 argument or finite simulation is not the all-r structural theorem.
